newsitem.title: USA: Cerion Technologies challenges hit Q1 net.
newsitem.headline: Cerion Technologies challenges hit Q1 net.

text.p: Cerion Technologies Inc said Thursday it continued to face what it called "significant challenges" in the first quarter ended March 28 that affected its business in the fourth quarter of 1996, lowering its earnings in the period.

The company reported net income of $66,000, or $0.01 a share, down sharply from the $1.8 million, or $0.34, posted a year ago. Sales fell to $8.3 million from $11.8 million in the first quarter of 1996.

Cerion, a maker of precision-machined aluminum disk substrates, said a change in its ability to project future customer orders also contributes to the difficulty in internally projecting operating results from quarter to quarter.
Cerion shares were off 1/8 Thursday at 4.
